name: Ayashi Orino
source:
A wealthy ojou-sama heroine who doesn't actually seem as such. Originally comes from a very strict family focusing on how she needs to represent their family, Orino meets Kazuki very early on when he breaks her paradigms and teaches her how fun childhood can be.

[Edited from [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2016/11/26/the-childrens-rebellion-review-of-161028-gusha-no-kyouben/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
